title: Set up the docker-linux runner in WSL2 Ubuntu and document both runners
goal: A GitLab Runner with the docker executor, tag docker-linux, concurrent 2, runs as a systemd service in WSL2 Ubuntu on the Windows runner's PC, kept running across sign-outs and restarts by a startup task, and is online for the project; its token went from glab api straight into gitlab-runner register and appears in no repository file; kb/_self/runners.md describes the docker-windows and docker-linux runners (host prerequisites, install, register, keep-alive, how to check them), with placeholders for host and user names, and has its map.csv row and README entry.

run: import pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/runners.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert 'docker-linux' in t and 'docker-windows' in t and 'glrt-' not in t

gates.question: Which Linux host should the Linux runner live in?
options: WSL2 Ubuntu on the Windows runner's PC
gates.recommendation: WSL2 Ubuntu on the Windows runner's PC
gates.answer: WSL2 Ubuntu on the Windows runner's PC

gates.question: How is the runner's authentication token created?
options: the agent, glab api piped into gitlab-runner register
the operator registers it by hand
gates.recommendation: the agent, glab api piped into gitlab-runner register
gates.answer: the agent, glab api piped into gitlab-runner register

gates.question: How many Linux jobs may run at once?
May the agent enable WSL2, which may need a Windows restart the operator does?
options: yes, after checking a restart is really needed
gates.recommendation: yes, after checking a restart is really needed
gates.answer: yes, after checking a restart is really needed

notes: Host work done by the orchestrating session with the operator (elevated, may need a restart); the commit is only the doc.
